def retirement_check(matrix: Path, paths: tuple[str, ...]):

    of the matrix not accredited; exit 1 when there is one, 0 when the retirement can be declared.
    Nothing is written."""
    from specir.visual.retirement import InventoryError, check, format_gate_report

    for item in paths:

"""The static extractor of specIR for Django REST Framework apps and their PostgreSQL schema.

`sldb.api.code.code_facts` gives the generic syntax (classes with `bases`, decorators with kwargs,
`calls`, assignments, calls of module level, SQL tables, columns and constraints); this package
interprets Django and DRF over those facts (`django_drf.py`, `sql.py`) and writes the domain types
of specIR, each with anchors on the facts it stands on (`write.py`). It reads no code itself.

    report = extract(project_root, store)    # an ExtractionReport

from pathlib import Path

import sldb.api as api

from sldb.api.code import code_facts

from specir.extract.django_drf import interpret
from specir.extract.facts import Facts
from specir.extract.plan import Planned
from specir.extract.react_tsx import interpret_frontend
from specir.extract.write import ExtractionReport, write_plan
from specir.install import package_pythonpath

__all__ = ["ExtractionReport", "extract", "extract_frontend"]


def extract(root: str | Path, store: str | Path | None = None, paths: list[str] | None = None) -> ExtractionReport:
    """Extract the backend and data nodes of the code under `root` into `store` (default
    `<root>/.sldb`), once per call and idempotent: the same code leaves the same store.

    Raises:
        ValueError: A fact's anchor does not match the fact; nothing is written.
    """
    root = Path(root).resolve()
    store_path = Path(store).resolve() if store is not None else root / ".sldb"
    facts = code_facts(root, paths)["facts"]
    plan = interpret(Facts(facts))
    nodes = [p for p in plan.nodes.values()]
    edges = [p for p in plan.edges.values()]
    return write_plan(store_path, root, package_pythonpath(), nodes, edges, list(dict.fromkeys(plan.not_derived)))


def extract_frontend(root: str | Path, store: str | Path | None = None, paths: list[str] | None = None) -> ExtractionReport:
    """Extract the interface nodes (InterfaceControlDoc, InterfaceActionDoc) of the TS, TSX, JS and JSX
    code under `root` into `store`, with `triggers` and `invokes` to the ApiOperationDoc already in the
    store (the backend extraction of `extract`). Idempotent; nothing is written if an anchor does not match.

    Raises:
        ValueError: A fact's anchor does not match the fact; nothing is written.
    """
    root = Path(root).resolve()
    store_path = Path(store).resolve() if store is not None else root / ".sldb"
    facts = code_facts(root, paths)["facts"]
    held = [d for d in api.load_runtime_documents(store_path, package_pythonpath()) if d.model_name == "ApiOperationDoc"]
    operations = [Planned("ApiOperationDoc", d.name, {"title": d.payload["title"], "method": d.payload.get("method"), "route": d.payload.get("route") or ""}, "derivado", "") for d in held if d.payload.get("method")]
    plan = interpret_frontend(Facts(facts), operations)
    return write_plan(store_path, root, package_pythonpath(), list(plan.nodes.values()), list(plan.edges.values()), list(dict.fromkeys(plan.not_derived)))

"""The rules of React and of HTTP clients over the generic facts of sldb for TS, TSX, JS and JSX:
`attrs.handlers` of a component (element, attribute, handler) and `attrs.calls` of a function or
component (name, first_arg, canonical). One mapping for the four extensions: it reads facts, never code.

What a rule reads as it stands is `observado` (the control a handler sits on, the action a handler
is); what it assembles is `derivado` (`triggers` control -> action, `invokes` action -> API operation).
Nothing here is `inferido` or `declarado`. A call that cannot be resolved is returned as not derived:
a declared gap (the facts do not show the method or the URL) or a breach (no operation in the graph)."""

from __future__ import annotations

from specir.extract.django_drf import Plan
from specir.extract.facts import Fact, Facts, last
from specir.extract.plan import Planned, node_name, sentence

#: The extensions whose facts this module maps (the same code for every one of them).
FRONTEND_SUFFIXES = (".ts", ".tsx", ".js", ".jsx")
HTTP_VERBS = {"get", "post", "put", "patch", "delete"}
CONTROL = "react-jsx-handler-element"
ACTION = "react-jsx-handler-function"
TRIGGERS = "react-handler-triggers-action"
INVOKES = "http-call-resolves-to-api-operation"


def normalize(route: str) -> tuple[str, ...]:
    """A route as segments, without query nor trailing slash, every `{x}` the same parameter."""
    path = route.split("?", 1)[0].split("#", 1)[0]
    return tuple("{}" if s.startswith("{") and s.endswith("}") else s for s in path.strip("/").split("/") if s)


def http_method(call: dict) -> str | None:
    """The method of an HTTP call (rule c): a canonical call whose last name segment is an HTTP verb
    and whose first argument is a literal route starting with `/`; else None."""
    first = call.get("first_arg")
    if call.get("canonical") and last(call["name"]).lower() in HTTP_VERBS and isinstance(first, str) and first.startswith("/"):
        return last(call["name"]).upper()
    return None


def _is_hole(call: dict) -> bool:
    """A call that looks like an HTTP call by its name but gives no literal route (a template with
    expressions, a variable, a non canonical callee)."""
    first = call.get("first_arg")
    verb = last(call["name"]).lower() in HTTP_VERBS and "." in call["name"]
    if last(call["name"]) == "fetch":
        return True  # the method is not in the facts, even when the URL is a literal
    return verb and not (call.get("canonical") and isinstance(first, str) and first.startswith("/"))


def interpret_frontend(facts: Facts, operations: list[Planned]) -> Plan:
    """Controls, actions, `triggers` and `invokes` of the frontend facts, resolved against `operations`
    (the ApiOperationDoc of the graph, as Planned without facts)."""
    plan = Plan()
    code = [f for f in facts.all if f["path"].endswith(FRONTEND_SUFFIXES)]
    frontend = Facts(code)
    functions: dict[str, list[Fact]] = {}
    for fact in frontend.of_kind("function", "component"):
        functions.setdefault(fact["qualified_name"], []).append(fact)
    for component in frontend.of_kind("component"):
        handlers = component["attrs"].get("handlers") or []
        seen: dict[str, int] = {}
        for entry in handlers:
            key = f"{entry['element']}.{entry['attribute']}"
            seen[key] = seen.get(key, 0) + 1
            _handler(plan, frontend, functions, operations, component, entry, seen[key], len(handlers))
    return plan


def _handler(plan, facts, functions, operations, component, entry, index, total) -> None:
    where = f"{component['path']}:{component['span']['start_line']}"
    element, attribute, name = entry["element"], entry["attribute"], entry["handler"]
    suffix = "" if index == 1 else f".{index}"
    control = plan.node(Planned("InterfaceControlDoc", node_name("InterfaceControlDoc", f"{component['id']}.{element}.{attribute}{suffix}"), {
        "title": f"{component['qualified_name']} {element}", "kind": element, "component": component["qualified_name"],
        "description": sentence(CONTROL, [component], derived=False)}, "observado", CONTROL, [component]))
    own = [f for f in functions.get(name, []) if f["attrs"]["module"] == component["attrs"]["module"] and f is not component]
    handler = own[0] if len(own) == 1 else None
    used = [component, *([handler] if handler else [])]
    event = attribute[2:].lower() if attribute.startswith("on") else attribute.lower()
    action = plan.node(Planned("InterfaceActionDoc", node_name("InterfaceActionDoc", f"{component['id']}.{name}"), {
        "title": name, "event": event, "description": sentence(ACTION, used, derived=False)}, "observado", ACTION, used))
    plan.edge("triggers", control, action, TRIGGERS, [component], f"El elemento {element} liga {attribute} a {name} (línea {component['span']['start_line']}).")
    if handler is not None:
        calls, owner = handler["attrs"].get("calls") or [], handler
    elif not own and total == 1:
        # the handler is declared inside the component: sldb gives its calls with the component's own
        calls, owner = component["attrs"].get("calls") or [], component

        plan.not_derived.append(f"{where} {name}: el handler no es un fact único y el componente tiene más de un handler; no se sabe qué llamadas son suyas")

def _call(plan, facts, functions, operations, action, component, owner, call, depth) -> None:

    method = http_method(call)
    if method is not None:

def _resolve(plan, operations, action, component, owner, call, method, here) -> None:
    wanted = normalize(call["first_arg"])
    matches = [o for o in operations if o.fields["method"] == method and normalize(o.fields["route"]) == wanted]

        reason = "ninguna ApiOperationDoc del grafo con ese método y ruta (brecha hacia un endpoint ausente)" if not matches else "más de una ApiOperationDoc del grafo casa"
        plan.not_derived.append(f"{here} {call['name']}({call['first_arg']!r}): {reason}: {method} {call['first_arg']}")

    plan.edge("invokes", action, matches[0], INVOKES, facts, f"La llamada {call['name']} (línea {call['line']}) es {method} {call['first_arg']}, que casa con {matches[0].fields['title']}.")

"""Rule `sql-create-table`: the tables of the SQL files, with their columns and keys, read from the
`table`, `column` and `constraint` facts of sldb (a primary key is `attrs.primary_key` of its
column, the others `constraint_type` facts with `columns` and `references`)."""

from __future__ import annotations

from specir.extract.facts import Fact, Facts
from specir.extract.plan import Planned, node_name, sentence

RULE = "sql-create-table"
SCHEMA_UNKNOWN = "el SQL leído no dice el esquema de la tabla"


def column_text(column: Fact) -> str:
    attrs = column["attrs"]
    extras = [word for key, word in (("primary_key", "PK"), ("identity", "identity")) if attrs.get(key)]
    return " ".join([column["qualified_name"].split(".", 1)[1], attrs.get("type", ""), *extras]).strip()


def constraint_text(constraint: Fact) -> str:
    attrs = constraint["attrs"]
    text = f"{attrs['constraint_type']} {constraint['qualified_name'].split('.', 1)[1]} ({', '.join(attrs.get('columns') or [])})"
    reference = attrs.get("references")
    return f"{text} -> {reference['table']} ({', '.join(reference['columns'])})" if reference else text


def tables(facts: Facts) -> dict[str, Planned]:
    """One TableDoc per `table` fact, by table name; observado, because a table, its columns and its
    keys are read as they are written."""
    planned: dict[str, Planned] = {}
    for table in facts.of_kind("table"):
        columns = facts.members(table, "column")
        constraints = facts.members(table, "constraint")
        used = [table, *columns, *constraints]
        detail = "; ".join([*(column_text(c) for c in columns), *(constraint_text(c) for c in constraints)])
        name = table["qualified_name"]
        description = f"{sentence(RULE, used, derived=False)} Columnas y claves: {detail}."
        fields = {
            "title": name, "description": description, "schema_name": None, "desconocidos": {"schema_name": SCHEMA_UNKNOWN},
            "columns": [c["qualified_name"].split(".", 1)[1] for c in columns],
        }
        planned[name] = Planned("TableDoc", node_name("TableDoc", name), fields, "observado", RULE, used)
    return planned

def relation_type_seeds() -> list[api.Seed]:
    """One managed document seed per relation type of `relation_types.yaml`."""
    seeds = []

def rule_seeds() -> list[api.Seed]:
    """One managed document seed per rule of `rules.yaml`."""
    seeds = []
    for spec in _data("rules.yaml"):
        name = spec["name"]

def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="specir-install", description="Install specIR's domain models, relation types and rules in an SLDB store.")
    parser.add_argument("--store", required=True, help="The store (its .sldb directory or its project).")

import yaml
from sldb.api.matching import (
    SpecView,
    StoreReader,
    attach_atom_edges,
    build_coverage_by_view,
    build_explicit_atoms,
    build_explicit_refs,
    filter_atoms_payload,
    raw_atoms_by_view,
)
from sldb.api.notations import find_store

from specir.visual.catalog.loader import CatalogItem, find_monorepo_root, resolve_spec_path
from specir.visual.catalog.sections import resolve_item_path


def item_specs(item: CatalogItem) -> list[dict]:
    """The YAML specs of a view that could be read, as dicts."""
    specs = []
    for spec_ref in item.specs:
        spec_path = resolve_spec_path(spec_ref, Path(item.source_base_dir))
        if spec_path is None:
            continue
        try:
            spec = yaml.safe_load(spec_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")) or {}
        except Exception:
            continue
        if isinstance(spec, dict):
            specs.append(spec)
    return specs


def _src_path(item: CatalogItem) -> Path | None:
    if not item.src:
        return None
    return resolve_item_path(item.src.split("#", 1)[0], Path(item.source_base_dir), "src").resolve()


def _boundary(item: CatalogItem, src_path: Path | None) -> Path | None:
    """The project's folder (`<monorepo root>/<project>`) a view's store must live in, if any."""
    if not item.project:
        return None
    probe = src_path.parent if src_path is not None else Path(item.source_base_dir)
    root = find_monorepo_root(probe.resolve())
    boundary = (root / item.project).resolve() if root is not None else None
    return boundary if boundary is not None and boundary.exists() else None


def view_store(item: CatalogItem) -> Path | None:
    """The `.sldb` of a view: the nearest one sldb recognizes above its `src`, then above its
    config, inside its project's folder when it has one."""
    src_path = _src_path(item)
    boundary = _boundary(item, src_path)
    for start in [*([src_path.parent] if src_path is not None else []), Path(item.source_base_dir)]:
        store = find_store(start)
        if store is not None and (boundary is None or store.parent.is_relative_to(boundary)):
            return store
    return None


def spec_view(item: CatalogItem) -> SpecView:
    """A catalog view as sldb's `SpecView`: its specs loaded and its store found."""
    return SpecView(
        key=item.anchor_id, id=item.id, specs=item_specs(item), source=item.src or "", base_dir=item.source_base_dir,
        store=view_store(item), title=item.title, diagram_type=item.diagram_type, scope=item.project,
    )


def split_shared_atoms(atoms_by_view: dict[str, dict[str, dict]]) -> tuple[dict[str, dict], dict[str, dict[str, dict]]]:
    """Moves the most repeated (non empty) payload to a common `ATOMS_DB`, emitted once: the
    template falls back to `ATOMS_DB` when a view is not in `ATOMS_BY_VIEW`."""
    counts: dict[str, int] = {}
    for payload in (p for p in atoms_by_view.values() if p):
        key = json.dumps(payload, sort_keys=True)
        counts[key] = counts.get(key, 0) + 1
    if not counts:
        return {}, atoms_by_view
    shared_key, shared_count = max(counts.items(), key=lambda kv: kv[1])
    if shared_count < 2:
        return {}, atoms_by_view
    rest = {view: payload for view, payload in atoms_by_view.items() if not (payload and json.dumps(payload, sort_keys=True) == shared_key)}
    return json.loads(shared_key), rest


@dataclass
class CatalogAtoms:
    """What the page embeds about atoms, as the template reads it (`window.*`)."""

    shared: dict[str, dict] = field(default_factory=dict)
    by_view: dict[str, dict] = field(default_factory=dict)
    explicit: dict[str, dict] = field(default_factory=dict)
    linked: dict[str, dict] = field(default_factory=dict)
    refs: dict[str, dict] = field(default_factory=dict)
    coverage: dict[str, dict] = field(default_factory=dict)
    warnings: list[dict] = field(default_factory=list)
    coverage_warnings: list[dict] = field(default_factory=list)


def _report(findings: list[Any]) -> list[dict]:
    for finding in findings:
        print(f"[specir][atoms] {finding.subject}: {finding.what}", file=sys.stderr)
    return [finding.as_dict() for finding in findings]


def catalog_atoms(items: list[CatalogItem], atoms_dir: Path | None = None, atoms_tags: list[str] | None = None, strict: bool = False) -> CatalogAtoms:
    """The atoms of the catalog's views through `sldb.api.matching`; with `strict` an unknown atom
    or ref raises sldb's `UnknownAtomError`."""
    views, reader = [spec_view(item) for item in items], StoreReader()
    raw, warnings = raw_atoms_by_view(views, atoms_dir, reader)
    explicit, complete, explicit_warnings, linked = build_explicit_atoms(views, raw, strict=strict)
    refs, ref_warnings = build_explicit_refs(views, reader, strict=strict)
    attach_atom_edges(views, explicit, linked, reader, raw)
    by_view = {view: filter_atoms_payload(payload, atoms_tags) if atoms_tags else payload for view, payload in raw.items()}
    by_view.update({view: {} for view in complete})  # every node explicit: no fuzzy matching, nothing else embedded
    shared, by_view = split_shared_atoms(by_view)
    coverage, coverage_warnings = build_coverage_by_view(views)
    return CatalogAtoms(shared, by_view, explicit, linked, refs, coverage, _report([*warnings, *explicit_warnings, *ref_warnings]),
                        [finding.as_dict() for finding in coverage_warnings])


def atoms_script(atoms: CatalogAtoms, metadata: str) -> str:
    """The `<script>` that hands the atoms to the template, right before `</body>`."""
    return (
        "\n<script>"
        f"window.ATOMS_DB = {json.dumps(atoms.shared)}; "
        f"window.ATOMS_BY_VIEW = {json.dumps(atoms.by_view)}; "
        f"window.ATOMS_EXPLICIT = {json.dumps(atoms.explicit)}; "
        f"window.ATOMS_LINKED = {json.dumps(atoms.linked)}; "
        f"window.REFS_EXPLICIT = {json.dumps(atoms.refs)}; "
        f"window.COVERAGE_BY_VIEW = {json.dumps(atoms.coverage)}; "
        f"window.SPEC2VIZ_ATOM_WARNINGS = {json.dumps(atoms.warnings)}; "
        f"window.SPEC2VIZ_COVERAGE_WARNINGS = {json.dumps(atoms.coverage_warnings)}; "
        f"window.SPEC2VIZ_CATALOG = {metadata};"
        "</script>\n</body>"
    )


__all__ = ["CatalogAtoms", "atoms_script", "catalog_atoms", "item_specs", "spec_view", "split_shared_atoms", "view_store"]

and `build_deskops`): the template (a local override next to the config, or the packaged
`templates/default.html` of IR12) filled with the navigation, the filter bar, the sections and the

from __future__ import annotations

import sys
from importlib import resources
from pathlib import Path

from specir.visual.catalog.annotations import AnnotationsTarget, annotations_script
from specir.visual.catalog.atoms import atoms_script, catalog_atoms
from specir.visual.catalog.loader import CatalogConfig, load_catalog
from specir.visual.catalog.sections import render_catalog_metadata, render_filter_bar, render_nav, render_sections


def catalog_template(catalog: CatalogConfig, base_dir: Path) -> str:
    """The local template the config names, if it exists; otherwise the packaged one."""
    local = base_dir / catalog.template if catalog.template else None
    if local and local.exists():
        print(f"specir: using local catalog template override: {local}", file=sys.stderr)
        return local.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    return resources.files("specir.visual").joinpath("templates", "default.html").read_text(encoding="utf-8")


def _fill(template: str, catalog: CatalogConfig, base_dir: Path) -> str:
    nav, filters, sections = render_nav(catalog.items), render_filter_bar(catalog.items), render_sections(catalog.items, base_dir)
    values = {
        "{{NAV}}": nav, "{{FILTERS}}": filters, "{{SECTIONS}}": sections, "{{PROJECT_NAME}}": catalog.project_name,
        "{{BRAND_NAME}}": catalog.brand_name, "{{BRAND_SUBTITLE}}": catalog.brand_subtitle, "{{CATALOG_TITLE}}": catalog.title,
        "{{CATALOG_METADATA}}": render_catalog_metadata(catalog, catalog.items),
    }
    page = template
    for marker, value in values.items():
        page = page.replace(marker, value)
    if "{{FILTERS}}" not in template and "{{SECTIONS}}" in template:
        page = page.replace(sections, filters + sections, 1)
    return page


def render_catalog(
    config_path: Path,
    base_dir: Path | None = None,
    atoms_dir: Path | None = None,
    atoms_tags: list[str] | None = None,
    strict_atoms: bool = False,
    annotations: AnnotationsTarget | None = None,
) -> str:
    """The catalog's HTML. `strict_atoms` turns an unknown `atoms:`/`refs:` id into sldb's
    `UnknownAtomError`; otherwise it is a warning on stderr and in the page."""
    catalog = load_catalog(config_path)
    base_dir = base_dir if base_dir is not None else config_path.parent
    page = _fill(catalog_template(catalog, base_dir), catalog, base_dir)
    atoms = catalog_atoms(catalog.items, atoms_dir, atoms_tags, strict_atoms)
    page = page.replace("{{ATOMS_DB}}", "{}")
    tail = atoms_script(atoms, render_catalog_metadata(catalog, catalog.items))
    if annotations is not None:
        tail = annotations_script(annotations, catalog.title, catalog.project_name) + tail
    return page.replace("</body>", tail)


def build_catalog(config_path: Path, out_path: Path, base_dir: Path | None = None, atoms_dir: Path | None = None,
                  atoms_tags: list[str] | None = None, strict_atoms: bool = False, annotations: AnnotationsTarget | None = None) -> Path:
    """Writes the catalog's HTML to `out_path`."""
    out_path.write_text(render_catalog(config_path, base_dir, atoms_dir, atoms_tags, strict_atoms, annotations), encoding="utf-8")
    return out_path


__all__ = ["build_catalog", "catalog_template", "render_catalog"]

def compile_ir(diagram: BaseDiagram):
    match diagram:
        case ClassDiagram():      return ClassCompiler().compile(diagram)
        case SequenceDiagram():   return SequenceCompiler().compile(diagram)
        case StateDiagram():      return StateCompiler().compile(diagram)
        case ComponentDiagram():  return ComponentCompiler().compile(diagram)

        case MatrixDiagram():     return MatrixCompiler().compile(diagram)
        case ReflectionDiagram(): return ReflectionCompiler().compile(diagram)

# Valid mermaid sequence arrows. Anything else between two participants that
# looks like an arrow is almost always a renderer bug.
_VALID_SEQ_ARROWS = ("->>", "-->>", "->", "-->", "-x", "--x", "-)", "--)")

_RULES: tuple[_Rule, ...] = (
    _Rule(
        name="invalid-return-arrow",
        # "A<<--B" or "A <<-- B": the reversed dashed arrow is not mermaid.
        pattern=re.compile(r"\S\s*<<--\s*\S"),
        message=(
            "invalid sequence arrow '<<--'. Mermaid return arrows are '-->>'. "
            "Use kind: return -> '-->>' (dashed, forward)."
        ),
    ),
    _Rule(
        name="raw-angle-brackets",
        # Unescaped <...> inside a message/label is parsed as HTML by mermaid
        # and silently drops or breaks the node. Only fires outside of a
        # recognised arrow token.
        pattern=re.compile(r"(?<![-<>x)])<(?!<)[^<>\n]*>"),
        message=(

            "breaks the diagram. Escape as '<...>' or drop the brackets."
        ),
    ),
    _Rule(
        name="empty-label-braces",
        pattern=re.compile(r"\{\s*\"\"\s*\}|\{\s*\}"),

def mmdc_path() -> str | None:
    """Return the mermaid-cli binary path if available, else None.

    Honors SPECIR_MMDC (or, as spec2viz did, SPEC2VIZ_MMDC) to point at a
    specific binary. Set it to 0 (or 'off'/'false') to force-disable the
    real-parser check.
    """
    override = os.environ.get("SPECIR_MMDC", os.environ.get("SPEC2VIZ_MMDC"))
    if override in {"0", "off", "false", "no"}:
        return None
    if override:
        return override if (Path(override).exists() or shutil.which(override)) else None

def _mmdc_check(text: str) -> list[str]:
    """Parse the mermaid text with the real mermaid-cli engine.

    Returns a list of problems (empty = clean). If mmdc is not installed the
    check is skipped and returns []. This is the source of truth: it catches
    browser-breaking syntax the regex heuristics miss (unescaped '()', '{}',
    nested quotes, HTML entities, etc.).
    """
    binary = mmdc_path()
    if not binary:
        return []
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as td:
        src = Path(td) / "diagram.mmd"
        out = Path(td) / "diagram.svg"
        src.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")
        try:
            proc = subprocess.run(
                [binary, "-i", str(src), "-o", str(out)],
                capture_output=True,
                text=True,
                timeout=60,
            )
        except (OSError, subprocess.TimeoutExpired) as exc:  # pragma: no cover
            return [f"mmdc could not run ({exc}); skipping real-parser check."]
        if proc.returncode == 0 and out.exists():
            return []
        detail = _extract_mmdc_error(proc.stdout, proc.stderr)
        return [f"mermaid engine (mmdc) rejected the diagram:\n    {detail}"]


def _extract_mmdc_error(stdout: str, stderr: str) -> str:
    blob = "\n".join(p for p in (stdout, stderr) if p).strip()
    lines = [ln for ln in blob.splitlines() if ln.strip()]
    picked = [ln.strip() for ln in lines if re.search(r"error|parse|expecting", ln, re.I)]
    chosen = picked or lines
    return "\n    ".join(chosen[:6]) or "unknown mmdc failure"


def _looks_like_sequence(text: str) -> bool:
    for line in text.splitlines():
        s = line.strip()
        if s:
            return s.startswith("sequenceDiagram")
    return False


def _check_sequence_arrows(text: str) -> list[str]:
    """Flag sequence message lines whose arrow token is not valid mermaid."""
    problems: list[str] = []
    msg_re = re.compile(r"^\s*(\w+)\s*([-<>x()]{2,4})\s*(\w+)\s*:")
    for i, line in enumerate(text.splitlines(), 1):
        m = msg_re.match(line)
        if not m:
            continue
        arrow = m.group(2)
        if arrow not in _VALID_SEQ_ARROWS:
            problems.append(
                f"line {i}: invalid sequence arrow '{arrow}'. "
                f"Valid arrows: {', '.join(_VALID_SEQ_ARROWS)}."
            )
    return problems


def lint_mermaid(text: str, *, check_html: bool = True) -> list[str]:
    """Return a list of human-readable problems. Empty list means clean.

    check_html controls the raw-angle-bracket rule. Pass check_html=False when
    the caller will HTML-escape the content before embedding (e.g. the deskops
    build wraps mermaid in <pre> and escapes '<' to '<' itself), so raw
    '<...>' in labels is safe in that path. Leave it True for standalone .mmd
    output that a mermaid engine parses verbatim.

    Does not raise; callers decide whether to raise MermaidLintError.
    """
    problems: list[str] = []
    lines = text.splitlines()

    for rule in _RULES:
        if rule.name == "raw-angle-brackets" and not check_html:
            continue
        for i, line in enumerate(lines, 1):
            if rule.pattern.search(line):
                problems.append(f"line {i}: {rule.message}\n    -> {line.strip()}")

    if _looks_like_sequence(text):
        problems.extend(_check_sequence_arrows(text))

    problems.extend(_mmdc_check(text))

    return problems


def assert_mermaid_ok(
    text: str, *, source: str | None = None, check_html: bool = True
) -> None:
    """Raise MermaidLintError if the mermaid text has breaking constructs."""
    problems = lint_mermaid(text, check_html=check_html)
    if problems:
        where = f" in {source}" if source else ""
        joined = "\n  - ".join(problems)
        raise MermaidLintError(
            f"Mermaid lint failed{where} ({len(problems)} issue(s)):\n  - {joined}"
        )

def render_to_file(
    path: str | Path,
    out: str | Path = ".",
    renderer: str | None = None,
) -> Path:

        output_path.write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2))

        result = with_provenance(renderer_name, path, result)
        if renderer_name == "mermaid":
            from specir.visual.lint_mermaid import assert_mermaid_ok

            assert_mermaid_ok(result, source=path.name)
        output_path.write_text(result)

    return output_path


def _write_bpmn(spec_path: Path, output_path: Path, xml: str, diagram: BaseDiagram) -> Path:
    """`<stem>.bpmn` (the XML) and `<stem>.bpmn.html` (the offline bpmn-js viewer)."""
    from specir.visual.renderers.bpmn import render_bpmn_html, with_xml_provenance

    output_path.write_text(with_xml_provenance(xml, provenance_text(spec_path)), encoding="utf-8")
    # description, preguntas_abiertas and legend are typed fields of the metadata model
    metadata = diagram.metadata.model_dump() if diagram.metadata else None
    page = render_bpmn_html(xml, diagram.title, metadata)
    output_path.with_name(output_path.name + ".html").write_text(page, encoding="utf-8")
    return output_path


# sintaxis de comentario de linea de cada salida de texto
_COMMENT_PREFIX = {"mermaid": "%%", "plantuml": "'", "d2": "#"}


def with_provenance(renderer_name: str, spec_path: str | Path, text: str) -> str:
    """El texto con su cabecera de trazabilidad. En mermaid, un frontmatter de config (`---`) tiene
    que ser la primera linea, asi que la cabecera va justo despues de el."""
    header = provenance_header(renderer_name, spec_path)
    if header and text.startswith("---\n"):
        end = text.find("\n---\n", 3)
        if end != -1:
            cut = end + len("\n---\n")
            return text[:cut] + header + text[cut:]
    return header + text


def provenance_header(renderer_name: str, spec_path: str | Path) -> str:
    """La cabecera de trazabilidad de una proyeccion de texto: de que spec sale y como se
    valida, para que nadie la edite a mano. Vacia para las salidas sin sintaxis de comentario."""
    prefix = _COMMENT_PREFIX.get(renderer_name)
    if prefix is None:
        return ""
    return f"{prefix} {provenance_text(spec_path)}\n"


def provenance_text(spec_path: str | Path) -> str:
    """El texto de la cabecera de trazabilidad, sin sintaxis de comentario."""
    spec = Path(spec_path)
    try:
        shown = spec.resolve().relative_to(Path.cwd().resolve())
    except ValueError:
        shown = spec
    return f"{COMMAND}: generated from {shown.as_posix()}; do not edit, run `sldb notations validate {shown.as_posix()}` and re-render"

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="es">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>MEPU · Cómo se decide una línea (R1–R5) y la OC</title>
<style>
/**
 * Semantic tokens, copied from `@bpmn-io/theme` to style the components
 * according to this theme.
 *
 * Names and values of the tokens should stay intact with the `@bpmn-io/theme`
 * source of truth, to ensure matching styles and allow overrides with an
 * alternative theme.
 */
.bio-theme-parent {
  --bio-surface: hsl(0, 0%, 100%);
  --bio-surface-overlay: hsl(0, 0%, 100%);
  --bio-surface-subtle: hsl(225, 10%, 97%);
  --bio-surface-medium: hsl(225, 10%, 95%);
  --bio-surface-inverted: hsl(0, 0%, 22%);
  --bio-surface-inverted-subtle: hsl(225, 10%, 35%);
  --bio-text: hsl(225, 10%, 15%);
  --bio-text-subtle: hsl(225, 10%, 35%);
  --bio-text-subtlest: hsl(225, 10%, 55%);
  --bio-text-on-inverted: hsl(0, 0%, 100%);
  --bio-border: hsl(225, 10%, 75%);
  --bio-border-disabled: hsl(225, 10%, 90%);
  --bio-primary: hsl(205, 100%, 40%);
  --bio-primary-surface: hsl(205, 100%, 95%);
  --bio-danger: hsl(360, 100%, 45%);
  --bio-danger-surface-subtle: hsl(360, 100%, 97%);
  --bio-selected-surface: var(--bio-surface-medium);
  --bio-selected-text: var(--bio-text);
  --bio-focus: hsl(205, 100%, 40%);
  --bio-focus-surface: hsl(205, 100%, 95%);
  --bio-canvas-accent: hsl(205, 100%, 40%);
  --bio-canvas-accent-subtle: hsl(205, 100%, 75%);
  --bio-shadow: hsla(0, 0%, 0%, 30%);
  --bio-shadow-subtle: hsla(0, 0%, 0%, 10%);
  --bio-radius-sm: 2px;
  --bio-radius-md: 3px;
  --bio-radius-lg: 4px;
}

/**
 * color definitions
 *
 * Colours resolve through the semantic tokens in `@bpmn-io/theme`; a handful of
 * values with no matching token stay literal.
 */
.djs-parent {

  --button-border-radius: var(--bio-radius-md);
  --input-border-radius: var(--bio-radius-sm);
  --surface-border-radius: var(--bio-radius-lg);

  --canvas-fill-color: var(--bio-surface);

  --accent-color: var(--bio-canvas-accent);

  --bendpoint-fill-color: var(--bio-canvas-accent);
  --bendpoint-stroke-color: var(--canvas-fill-color);

  --context-pad-entry-background-color: var(--bio-surface);
  --context-pad-entry-hover-background-color: var(--bio-surface-medium);

  --element-dragger-color: var(--accent-color);
  --element-selected-outline-stroke-color: var(--accent-color);
  --element-selected-outline-secondary-stroke-color: var(--bio-canvas-accent-subtle);

  --lasso-fill-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bio-canvas-accent) 15%, transparent);
  --lasso-stroke-color: var(--element-selected-outline-stroke-color);

  --palette-entry-color: var(--bio-text);
  --palette-entry-hover-color: var(--bio-primary);
  --palette-entry-selected-color: var(--bio-primary);
  --palette-separator-color: var(--bio-border);
  --palette-toggle-hover-background-color: var(--bio-surface-medium);
  --palette-background-color: var(--bio-surface-subtle);
  --palette-border-color: var(--bio-border);

  --popup-font-family: "IBM Plex Sans", sans-serif;
  --popup-font-size: 14px;
  --popup-secondary-font-size: .9em;
  --popup-header-entry-selected-color: var(--bio-primary);
  --popup-header-font-weight: bolder;
  --popup-header-group-divider-color: var(--bio-border);
  --popup-background-color: var(--bio-surface-overlay);
  --popup-border-color: transparent;
  --popup-shadow-color: var(--bio-shadow);
  /* translucent, so the thumb darkens whatever it scrolls over */
  --popup-scrollbar-thumb-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2);
  --popup-button-background-color: var(--bio-surface-overlay);
  --popup-button-hover-background-color: var(--bio-surface-medium);
  --popup-disabled-color: var(--bio-text-subtle);
  --popup-description-color: var(--bio-text-subtle);
  --popup-no-results-color: var(--bio-text-subtlest);
  --popup-entry-title-color: var(--bio-text-subtlest);

  --popup-entry-selected-background-color: var(--bio-selected-surface);
  --popup-entry-selected-color: var(--bio-selected-text);
  --popup-search-border-color: var(--bio-border);
  --popup-search-focus-border-color: var(--bio-focus);
  --popup-search-focus-background-color: var(--bio-focus-surface);
  --popup-tab-color: var(--bio-text-subtlest);
  --popup-tab-hover-color: var(--bio-text);
  --popup-tab-active-color: var(--bio-text);
  --popup-tab-active-border-color: var(--bio-primary);
  --popup-tab-strip-border-color: var(--bio-border-disabled);
  --popup-tab-focus-border-color: var(--bio-focus);

  --resizer-fill-color: var(--bio-canvas-accent);
  --resizer-stroke-color: var(--canvas-fill-color);

  --search-font-family: "IBM Plex Sans", sans-serif;
  --search-font-size: 14px;
  --search-container-background-color: var(--bio-surface-overlay);
  --search-shadow-color: var(--bio-shadow);
  --search-input-border-color: var(--bio-border);
  --search-input-focus-border-color: var(--bio-focus);
  --search-input-focus-background-color: var(--bio-primary-surface);
  --search-result-hover-background-color: var(--bio-surface-medium);
  --search-result-secondary-color: var(--bio-text-subtlest);
  --search-preselected-background-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bio-canvas-accent) 15%, transparent);

  --shape-attach-allowed-stroke-color: var(--accent-color);
  --shape-connect-allowed-fill-color: var(--bio-surface-subtle);
  --shape-drop-allowed-fill-color: var(--bio-surface-subtle);
  --shape-drop-not-allowed-fill-color: var(--bio-danger-surface-subtle);
  --shape-resize-preview-stroke-color: var(--accent-color);

  --snap-line-stroke-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bio-canvas-accent) 30%, transparent);

  --space-tool-crosshair-stroke-color: var(--bio-text);

  --tooltip-error-background-color: var(--bio-danger-surface-subtle);
  --tooltip-error-border-color: var(--bio-danger);
  --tooltip-error-color: var(--bio-danger);

  --hover-tooltip-font-family: "IBM Plex Sans", sans-serif;
  --hover-tooltip-font-size: 12px;
  --hover-tooltip-secondary-font-size: 11px;
  --hover-tooltip-background-color: var(--bio-surface-inverted);
  --hover-tooltip-color: var(--bio-text-on-inverted);
  --hover-tooltip-shadow-color: var(--bio-shadow-subtle);

  --palette-tooltip-shortcut-background-color: var(--bio-surface-inverted-subtle);
}

/**
 * SVG styles
 */

.djs-container svg.drop-not-ok {
  background: var(--shape-drop-not-allowed-fill-color) !important;
}

.djs-container svg.new-parent {
  background: var(--shape-drop-allowed-fill-color) !important;
}

.djs-container svg:focus {
  outline-offset: -1px;
}

/**
 * outline styles
 */

.djs-outline,
.djs-selection-outline {
  fill: none;
  shape-rendering: geometricPrecision;
  stroke-width: 2px;
}

.djs-outline {
  visibility: hidden;
}

.djs-selection-outline {
  stroke: var(--element-selected-outline-stroke-color);
}

.djs-element.selected .djs-outline {
  visibility: visible;

  stroke: var(--element-selected-outline-stroke-color);
}

.djs-connection.selected .djs-outline {
  display: none;
}

.djs-multi-select .djs-element.selected .djs-outline,
.djs-dragging-active-lasso .djs-element.selected .djs-outline {
  stroke: var(--element-selected-outline-secondary-stroke-color);
  display: block;
}

.djs-outline-hidden .djs-outline {
  display: none !important;
}

.djs-shape.connect-ok .djs-visual > :nth-child(1) {
  fill: var(--shape-connect-allowed-fill-color) !important;
}

.djs-shape.connect-not-ok .djs-visual > :nth-child(1),
.djs-shape.drop-not-ok .djs-visual > :nth-child(1) {
  fill: var(--shape-drop-not-allowed-fill-color) !important;
}

.djs-shape.new-parent .djs-visual > :nth-child(1) {
  fill: var(--shape-drop-allowed-fill-color) !important;
}


/* Override move cursor during drop and connect */
.drop-not-ok,
.connect-not-ok,
.drop-not-ok *,
.connect-not-ok * {
  cursor: not-allowed !important;
}

.drop-ok,
.connect-ok,
.drop-ok *,
.connect-ok * {
  cursor: default !important;
}

.djs-element.attach-ok .djs-visual > :nth-child(1) {
  stroke-width: 5px !important;
  stroke: var(--shape-attach-allowed-stroke-color) !important;
}

.djs-frame.connect-not-ok .djs-visual > :nth-child(1),
.djs-frame.drop-not-ok .djs-visual > :nth-child(1) {
  stroke-width: 3px !important;
  stroke: var(--shape-drop-not-allowed-fill-color) !important;
  fill: none !important;
}

/**
* Selection box style
*
*/
.djs-lasso-overlay {
  fill: var(--lasso-fill-color);
  stroke: var(--lasso-stroke-color);
  stroke-width: 2px;
  shape-rendering: geometricPrecision;
  pointer-events: none;
}

/**
 * Resize styles
 */
.djs-resize-overlay {
  fill: none;

  stroke-dasharray: 5 1 3 1;
  stroke: var(--shape-resize-preview-stroke-color);

  pointer-events: none;
}

.djs-resizer-hit {
  fill: none;
  pointer-events: all;
}

.djs-resizer-visual {
  fill: var(--resizer-fill-color);
  stroke-width: 1px;
  stroke: var(--resizer-stroke-color);
  shape-rendering: geometricPrecision;
}

.djs-resizer:hover .djs-resizer-visual {
  stroke: var(--resizer-stroke-color);
  stroke-opacity: 1;
}

.djs-cursor-resize-ns,
.djs-resizer-n,
.djs-resizer-s {
  cursor: ns-resize;
}

.djs-cursor-resize-ew,
.djs-resizer-e,
.djs-resizer-w {
  cursor: ew-resize;
}

.djs-cursor-resize-nwse,
.djs-resizer-nw,
.djs-resizer-se {
  cursor: nwse-resize;
}

.djs-cursor-resize-nesw,
.djs-resizer-ne,
.djs-resizer-sw {
  cursor: nesw-resize;
}

.djs-shape.djs-resizing > .djs-outline {
  visibility: hidden !important;
}

.djs-shape.djs-resizing > .djs-resizer {
  visibility: hidden;
}

.djs-dragger > .djs-resizer {
  visibility: hidden;
}

/**
 * drag styles
 */
.djs-dragger * {
  fill: none !important;
  stroke: var(--element-dragger-color) !important;
}

.djs-dragger tspan,
.djs-dragger text {
  fill: var(--element-dragger-color) !important;
  stroke: none !important;
}

.djs-dragger marker circle,
.djs-dragger marker path,
.djs-dragger marker polygon,
.djs-dragger marker polyline,
.djs-dragger marker rect {
  fill: var(--element-dragger-color) !important;
  stroke: none !important;
}

.djs-dragger marker text,
.djs-dragger marker tspan {
  fill: none !important;
  stroke: var(--element-dragger-color) !important;
}

.djs-dragging,
.djs-dragging > * {
  opacity: 0.3 !important;
  pointer-events: none !important;
}

/**
 * no pointer events for visual
 */
.djs-visual,
.djs-outline {
  pointer-events: none;
}

.djs-element.attach-ok .djs-hit {
  stroke-width: 60px !important;
}

/**
 * all pointer events for hit shape
 */
.djs-element > .djs-hit-all,
.djs-element > .djs-hit-no-move {
  pointer-events: all;
}

.djs-element > .djs-hit-stroke,
.djs-element > .djs-hit-click-stroke {
  pointer-events: stroke;
}

/**
 * shape / connection basic styles
 */
.djs-connection .djs-visual {
  stroke-width: 2px;
  fill: none;
}

.djs-cursor-grab {
  cursor: -webkit-grab;
  cursor: -moz-grab;
  cursor: grab;
}

.djs-cursor-grabbing {
  cursor: -webkit-grabbing;
  cursor: -moz-grabbing;
  cursor: grabbing;
}

.djs-cursor-crosshair {
  cursor: crosshair;
}

.djs-cursor-move {
  cursor: move;
}

.djs-cursor-resize-ns {
  cursor: ns-resize;
}

.djs-cursor-resize-ew {
  cursor: ew-resize;
}


/**
 * snapping
 */
.djs-snap-line {
  stroke: var(--snap-line-stroke-color);
  stroke-linecap: round;
  stroke-width: 2px;
  pointer-events: none;
}

/**
 * snapping
 */
.djs-crosshair {
  stroke: var(--space-tool-crosshair-stroke-color);
  stroke-linecap: round;
  stroke-width: 1px;
  pointer-events: none;
  shape-rendering: geometricPrecision;
  stroke-dasharray: 5, 5;
}

/**
 * palette
 */

.djs-palette {
  position: absolute;
  left: 20px;
  top: 20px;

  box-sizing: border-box;
  width: 48px;
}

.djs-palette .separator {
  margin: 5px;
  padding-top: 5px;

  border: none;
  border-bottom: solid 1px var(--palette-separator-color);

  clear: both;
}

.djs-palette .entry:before {
  vertical-align: initial;
}

.djs-palette .djs-palette-toggle {
  cursor: pointer;
}

.djs-palette .entry,
.djs-palette .djs-palette-toggle {
  color: var(--palette-entry-color);
  font-size: 30px;

  text-align: center;
}

.djs-palette .entry {
  float: left;
}

.djs-palette .entry img {
  max-width: 100%;
}

.djs-palette .djs-palette-entries:after {
  content: '';
  display: table;
  clear: both;
}

.djs-palette .djs-palette-toggle:hover {
  background: var(--palette-toggle-hover-background-color);
}

.djs-palette .entry:hover {
  color: var(--palette-entry-hover-color);
}

.djs-palette .highlighted-entry {
  color: var(--palette-entry-selected-color) !important;
}

.djs-palette .entry,
.djs-palette .djs-palette-toggle {
  width: 46px;
  height: 46px;
  line-height: 46px;
  cursor: default;
}

/**
 * Palette open / two-column layout is controlled via
 * classes on the palette. Events to hook into palette
 * changed life-cycle are available in addition.
 */
.djs-palette.two-column.open {
  width: 94px;
}

.djs-palette:not(.open) .djs-palette-entries {
  display: none;
}

.djs-palette:not(.open) {
  overflow: hidden;
}

.djs-palette.open .djs-palette-toggle {
  display: none;
}

.djs-hover-tooltip {
  position: fixed;
  z-index: 1000;

  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;

  padding: 6px 10px;
  border-radius: var(--surface-border-radius);

  background-color: var(--hover-tooltip-background-color);
  color: var(--hover-tooltip-color);

  font-family: var(--hover-tooltip-font-family);
  font-size: var(--hover-tooltip-font-size);
  line-height: 1.2;
  white-space: nowrap;

  pointer-events: none;
  box-shadow: 0 1px 4px var(--hover-tooltip-shadow-color);
}

.djs-hover-tooltip--right {
  transform: translateY(-50%);
}

.djs-hover-tooltip--top {
  transform: translate(-50%, -100%);
}

.djs-palette-tooltip-shortcut {
  padding: 1px 5px;

  border-radius: var(--button-border-radius);

  background-color: var(--palette-tooltip-shortcut-background-color);

  font-family: monospace;
  font-size: var(--hover-tooltip-secondary-font-size);
  line-height: 1.2;
}

/**
 * context-pad
 */
.djs-context-pad {
  position: absolute;
  display: none;
  pointer-events: none;
  line-height: 1;
  width: 72px;
  z-index: 100;
}

.djs-context-pad .entry {
  width: 22px;
  height: 22px;
  text-align: center;
  display: inline-block;
  font-size: 22px;
  margin: 0 2px 2px 0;

  border-radius: 3px;

  cursor: default;

  background-color: var(--context-pad-entry-background-color);
  box-shadow: 0 0 2px 1px var(--context-pad-entry-background-color);
  pointer-events: all;
  vertical-align: middle;
}

.djs-context-pad .entry:hover {
  background: var(--context-pad-entry-hover-background-color);
}

.djs-context-pad.open {
  display: block;
}

/**
 * popup styles
 */
.djs-popup {
  line-height: 1;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  background: var(--popup-background-color);
  overflow: hidden;
  position: fixed;
  z-index: 200;
  box-shadow: 0px 2px 6px var(--popup-shadow-color);
  border: solid 1px var(--popup-border-color);
  min-width: 120px;
  max-width: 300px;
  outline: none;
  font-size: var(--popup-font-size);
  font-family: var(--popup-font-family);
}

.djs-popup-search input {
  width: 100%;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  font-size: var(--popup-font-size);
  padding: 3px 6px 3px 28px;
  border-radius: var(--input-border-radius);
  border: solid 1px var(--popup-search-border-color);
  line-height: 21px;
}

.djs-popup-search input:focus {
  background-color: var(--popup-search-focus-background-color);
  border: solid 1px var(--popup-search-focus-border-color);
  outline: none;
}

.djs-popup-header {
  display: flex;
  align-items: stretch;
  line-height: 20px;
  margin: 10px 12px 10px 12px;
}

.djs-popup-header .entry {
  border-radius: 2px;
}

.djs-popup button.entry {
  padding: 0;
  background: transparent;
  border: 0;
}

.djs-popup-header .entry.active {
  color: var(--popup-header-entry-selected-color);
}

.djs-popup-header .entry.disabled {
  color: inherit;
}

.djs-popup-header-group {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: row;
  align-items: center;
  list-style: none;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
}

.djs-popup-header-group .entry {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: row;
  align-items: center;
}

.djs-popup-header-group + .djs-popup-header-group:before {
  content: '';
  width: 1px;
  height: 20px;
  background: var(--popup-header-group-divider-color);
  margin: 0 5px;
}

.djs-popup-search {
  position: relative;
  width: auto;
  margin: 10px 12px;
}

.djs-popup-tabs-container {
  position: relative;
  border-bottom: solid 1px var(--popup-tab-strip-border-color);
}

/**
 * The scroll control doubles as the edge fade: tabs scrolled past it fade out
 * rather than being cut off behind an opaque block.
 */
.djs-popup-tabs-scroll {
  appearance: none;
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  bottom: 1px;
  width: 28px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  padding: 0;
  border: none;
  border-radius: 0;
  color: var(--popup-tab-color);
  cursor: pointer;
}

.djs-popup-tabs-scroll:hover {
  color: var(--popup-tab-hover-color);
}

.djs-popup-tabs-scroll-start {
  left: 0;
  justify-content: flex-start;
  background: linear-gradient(to left, transparent, var(--popup-background-color) 60%);
}

.djs-popup-tabs-scroll-end {
  right: 0;
  justify-content: flex-end;
  background: linear-gradient(to right, transparent, var(--popup-background-color) 60%);
}

.djs-popup-tabs-scroll-start svg {
  transform: rotate(180deg);
}

.djs-popup-tabs {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: nowrap;
  gap: 2px;
  overflow-x: auto;
  overflow-y: hidden;
  padding: 0 12px;

  /* keep scrolled-to tabs clear of the scroll controls */
  scroll-padding: 0 28px;
  scrollbar-width: none;
}

.djs-popup-tabs::-webkit-scrollbar {
  display: none;
}

.djs-popup-tab {
  appearance: none;
  background: transparent;
  border: none;
  border-bottom: solid 2px transparent;
  border-radius: 0;
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  padding: 6px 10px;
  font: inherit;
  font-size: var(--popup-font-size);
  color: var(--popup-tab-color);
  cursor: pointer;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.djs-popup-tab:hover {
  color: var(--popup-tab-hover-color);
}

.djs-popup-tab:focus-visible {
  outline: solid 1px var(--popup-tab-focus-border-color);
  outline-offset: -2px;
}

.djs-popup-tab[aria-selected="true"] {
  color: var(--popup-tab-active-color);
  border-bottom-color: var(--popup-tab-active-border-color);
  font-weight: var(--popup-header-font-weight);
}

.djs-popup-title {
  font-size: var(--popup-font-size);
  font-weight: var(--popup-header-font-weight);
  flex: 1;
  margin: 0;
}

.djs-popup-breadcrumbs {
  display: flex;
  line-height: 20px;
  margin: 10px 12px;
}

.djs-popup-breadcrumbs-item {
  display: inline-flex;
  min-width: 0;
  padding: 0;
  margin: 0;
  background: transparent;
  border: 0;
  outline: none;
  appearance: none;
  color: var(--popup-description-color);
  font: inherit;
  cursor: pointer;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.djs-popup-breadcrumbs-item--separator::before {
  display: inline-block;
  content: '/';
  color: var(--popup-description-color);
  margin: 0 4px;
}

.djs-popup-breadcrumbs-item:hover {
  color: inherit;
  text-decoration: underline;
}

.djs-popup-breadcrumbs-item:focus-visible {
  outline: 1px solid var(--popup-search-focus-border-color);
  outline-offset: 2px;
}

.djs-popup-breadcrumbs-item--back {
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  padding: 2px 3px;
  margin-right: 6px;
  border: 1px solid var(--popup-search-border-color);
  border-radius: 4px;
}

.djs-popup-breadcrumbs-item--back:hover {
  background: var(--popup-button-hover-background-color);
}

.djs-popup-breadcrumbs-item--current {
  font-weight: var(--popup-header-font-weight);
  color: inherit;
  cursor: default;
}

.djs-popup-breadcrumbs-item--current:hover {
  text-decoration: none;
}

.djs-popup-entry-actions {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  gap: 6px;
  margin-left: 6px;
}

.djs-popup-entry-chevron {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  color: var(--popup-description-color);
}

.djs-popup-search-icon {
  position: absolute;
  left: 8px;
  top: 7px;
}

.djs-popup-search-count {
  margin: 0 12px;
  font-size: var(--popup-secondary-font-size);
  color: var(--popup-description-color);
}

.djs-popup-results {
  margin: 7px 3px 7px 12px;
  list-style: none;
  max-height: 280px;
  overflow: auto;
  padding-right: 9px;
}

/**
 * The results list is focusable (as a listbox holding
 * `aria-activedescendant`) when there is no search field.
 * The active entry is indicated via `.entry.selected`, so we hide
 * the outline on the list container itself.
 */
.djs-popup-results:focus {
  outline: none;
}

.djs-popup-group {
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  width: 100%;
}

.djs-popup-body .entry,
.djs-popup-body .entry-header {
  padding: 5px 7px;
  cursor: default;
  border-radius: 4px;
}

.djs-popup-body .entry-header {
  font-weight: var(--popup-header-font-weight);
  color: var(--popup-entry-title-color);
  padding-left: 0;
}

.djs-popup [class*="icon"] .djs-popup-label,
.djs-popup-label:not(:first-child) {
  margin-left: .5em;
}

.djs-popup [class*="icon"]:before,
.djs-popup-entry-icon {
  width: 1em;
  height: 1em;
  display: inline-block;
  font-size: 1.4em;
  vertical-align: middle;
}

.djs-popup-body .entry-header:not(:first-child) {
  margin-top: 8px;
  margin-bottom: 2px;
}

.djs-popup-body .entry {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: row;
  align-items: stretch;
  height: min-content;
}

.djs-popup .entry.selected {
  color: var(--popup-entry-selected-color);
  background-color: var(--popup-entry-selected-background-color);
}

.djs-popup .entry.disabled {
  color: var(--popup-disabled-color);
  cursor: not-allowed;
}

.djs-popup-body .entry:not(:first-child) {
  margin-top: 2px;
}

.djs-popup-entry-content {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  flex: 1;
}

.djs-popup-entry-description {
  font-size: var(--popup-secondary-font-size);
  margin-top: .25em;

  color: var(--popup-description-color);
}

.djs-popup-label,
.djs-popup-entry-description {
  line-height: 1.4em;
}

.djs-popup .entry,
.djs-popup .entry-header {
  margin: 1px;
}

.djs-popup-body {
  flex-direction: column;
  width: auto;
}

.djs-popup *::-webkit-scrollbar {
  width: 6px;
}

.djs-popup *::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
  border-radius: 3px;
  background-color: var(--popup-scrollbar-thumb-color);
}

.djs-popup *::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
  box-shadow: none;
  background: transparent;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 5px;
}

.djs-popup-no-results {
  padding: 0 12px 12px 12px;
  color: var(--popup-no-results-color);
}

.djs-popup-footer {
  display: flex;
  padding: 5px 12px 7px 12px;
  border-top: solid 1px var(--popup-border-color);
}

/**
 * The footer holds the keyboard/assistive-technology reachable documentation
 * link. Pointer interaction switches the popup to the per-entry
 * `.djs-popup-entry-docs` affordance instead.
 */
.djs-popup--pointer .djs-popup-footer {
  display: none;
}

.djs-popup-entry-docs {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  visibility: hidden;
  padding: 2px 3px;
  color: var(--popup-description-color);
  background: var(--popup-button-background-color);
  border: 1px solid var(--popup-search-border-color);
  border-radius: 4px;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: background-color .12s ease, border-color .12s ease, color .12s ease;
}

.djs-popup--pointer .djs-popup-body .entry:hover .djs-popup-entry-docs {
  visibility: visible;
}

.djs-popup-body .entry .djs-popup-entry-docs:hover {
  background: var(--popup-button-hover-background-color);
}

.djs-popup-entry-docs svg {
  vertical-align: middle;
}

.djs-popup-footer-docs {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 3px;
  font-size: var(--popup-secondary-font-size);
  color: var(--popup-description-color);
  text-decoration: none;
}

.djs-popup-footer-docs:hover {
  text-decoration: underline;
}

.djs-popup-footer-docs svg {
  vertical-align: middle;
  margin: 2px;
}

/**
 *  palette styles
 */
.djs-palette {
  background: var(--palette-background-color);
  border: solid 1px var(--palette-border-color);
  border-radius: var(--surface-border-radius);
}

/**
 * bendpoints
 */
.djs-segment-dragger,
.djs-bendpoint {
  display: none;
}

.djs-segment-dragger .djs-visual {
  display: none;

  fill: var(--bendpoint-fill-color);
  stroke: var(--bendpoint-stroke-color);
  stroke-width: 1px;
  stroke-opacity: 1;
}

.djs-segment-dragger:hover .djs-visual {
  display: block;
}

.djs-bendpoint .djs-visual {

<header>
  <div class="row">
    <h1>MEPU · Cómo se decide una línea (R1–R5) y la OC</h1>
    <div class="toolbar">
      <button type="button" id="fit">Fit</button>
      <button type="button" id="zoom-in">Zoom +</button>
      <button type="button" id="zoom-out">Zoom −</button>
      <button type="button" id="toggle-panel">Detalle</button>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="row second">
    <details class="meta">
      <summary>Descripción y preguntas abiertas</summary>
      <div class="meta-body">
      <p class="description">Todas las reglas se aplican a cada línea y la línea toma el peor resultado (No aceptar > Revisar > Aceptar con marcas > Aceptar); la OC toma el peor veredicto de sus líneas. Revisar dice a quién le toca (comprador, Customer Service, Comercial). Las alertas (fuera de plazo, varias direcciones, información mixta) no cambian el veredicto. Lo «por definir» de la fuente está resuelto hoy en el código con un valor provisional (marcado aquí).</p>
      <h2>Preguntas abiertas</h2>
      <ul class="preguntas-abiertas">
        <li>R2 parcial = Aceptar y avisar: pendiente de confirmación de Karina (README §6.1).</li>
        <li>R2 con varias líneas de la misma OC y el mismo SKU: cada línea se compara contra toda la foto; repartir el stock (en orden o acumulado) está por definir (README §3, REV-3).</li>
        <li>R2 pendiente de stock (DEC-128): el plazo de «a tiempo» (días desde el corte) y la confiabilidad y cadencia del informe PEND se confirman con Giuseppe (acuerdos.md fila 9).</li>
        <li>R4: si Giuseppe puede liberar reservas de otro cliente (README §6.3); la lista completa de cautelas de Lab Chile (ANT-14).</li>
        <li>R5 precio que no calza: por definir; el código usa Revisar (Comercial). Sin negocio vigente no aplica: el archivo no cubre a las OCs abiertas (docs/analisis/2026-10-21-r5-sin-cruces-collective.md).</li>
      </ul>
      </div>
    </details>
  <div class="legend" aria-label="Leyenda de colores">
    <span class="title">Colores:</span>
    <span class="item"><i class="swatch" style="background:#F4F0FB;border-color:#7E57C2"></i>gateway por defecto</span>
  </div>
  </div>
  <div id="error"></div>
</header>
<main>
  <div id="canvas"></div>
  <aside id="panel" aria-live="polite">
    <h2>Detalle</h2>
    <p class="muted" id="panel-body">Haz clic en una tarea, gateway o subproceso.</p>
  </aside>

  var viewer = new BpmnJS({
    container: '#canvas',
    textRenderer: {
      defaultStyle: { fontFamily: 'Arial, sans-serif', fontSize: 14, lineHeight: 1.2 },
      externalStyle: { fontFamily: 'Arial, sans-serif', fontSize: 14, lineHeight: 1.2 }
    }
  });
  window.bpmnViewer = viewer;
  var MIN_ZOOM = 0.6;  // the initial view never shows the diagram smaller than this
  function fitViewport() {
    viewer.get('canvas').zoom('fit-viewport', 'auto');
  }
  function initialView() {
    fitViewport();
    var canvas = viewer.get('canvas');
    if (canvas.zoom() < MIN_ZOOM) {
      // too big to fit legibly: zoom in and start at the diagram's left edge,
      // with the start event in view, instead of in the middle of the flow
      canvas.zoom(MIN_ZOOM);
      var start = viewer.get('elementRegistry').filter(function (el) {
        return el.type === 'bpmn:StartEvent';
      })[0];
      if (start) {
        var box = canvas.getAbsoluteBBox(start);
        var outer = canvas.viewbox().outer;
        canvas.scroll({ dx: 40 - box.x, dy: Math.round(outer.height * 0.4) - box.y });
      }
    }
  }
  function el(tag, text, cls) {
    var node = document.createElement(tag);
    if (text !== undefined && text !== null) { node.textContent = text; }
    if (cls) { node.className = cls; }
    return node;
  }
  function showInfo(id) {
    var data = info[id];
    var body = document.getElementById('panel-body');
    body.className = '';
    body.textContent = '';
    if (!data) {
      body.className = 'muted';
      body.textContent = 'Sin informacion para este elemento.';
      return;
    }
    body.appendChild(el('p', data.label, 'element-label'));
    if (data.detail) {
      body.appendChild(el('h3', data.subprocess ? 'Detalle del grupo' : 'Detalle'));
      body.appendChild(el('p', data.detail));
    }
    body.appendChild(el('h3', 'Ramas salientes'));
    if (!data.branches.length) {
      body.appendChild(el('p', 'Sin ramas.', 'muted'));
    } else {
      var ul = el('ul');
      data.branches.forEach(function (branch) {
        var li = el('li');
        if (branch.label) { li.appendChild(el('span', branch.label, 'branch-label')); li.appendChild(document.createTextNode(' → ')); }
        li.appendChild(document.createTextNode(branch.target));
        ul.appendChild(li);
      });
      body.appendChild(ul);
    }
  }
  viewer.on('element.click', function (evt) { showInfo(evt.element.id); });
  viewer.on('root.set', function () { try { initialView(); } catch (e) {} });
  viewer.importXML(xml).then(function (result) {
    if (result.warnings && result.warnings.length) { console.warn('bpmn-js import warnings', result.warnings); }
    initialView();
    window.bpmnReady = true;
  }).catch(function (err) {
    document.getElementById('error').textContent = 'Could not render the BPMN diagram: ' + err.message;
    console.error(err);
  });
  document.getElementById('fit').addEventListener('click', fitViewport);
  document.getElementById('zoom-in').addEventListener('click', function () { viewer.get('zoomScroll').stepZoom(1); });
  document.getElementById('zoom-out').addEventListener('click', function () { viewer.get('zoomScroll').stepZoom(-1); });
  document.getElementById('toggle-panel').addEventListener('click', function () {
    document.body.classList.toggle('panel-collapsed');
    setTimeout(function () { viewer.get('canvas').resized(); }, 0);
  });
  window.addEventListener('resize', function () { viewer.get('canvas').resized(); });
})();

SpecDoc:negocio-decision.title: MEPU · Cómo se decide una línea (R1–R5) y la OC
SpecDoc:negocio-decision.description: Todas las reglas se aplican a cada línea y la línea toma el peor resultado (No aceptar > Revisar > Aceptar con marcas > Aceptar); la OC toma el peor veredicto de sus líneas. Revisar dice a quién le toca (comprador, Customer Service, Comercial). Las alertas (fuera de plazo, varias direcciones, información mixta) no cambian el veredicto. Lo «por definir» de la fuente está resuelto hoy en el código con un valor provisional (marcado aquí).

SpecNodeDoc:negocio-decision.linea.title: Una línea de una OC abierta (4 o 5) de Laboratorio Chile

SpecNodeDoc:negocio-decision.no_aceptar_.title: No aceptar (todavía): sin stock y sin ingreso confirmado a tiempo (decisión del 2026-10-22)

SpecNodeDoc:negocio-decision.oc.title: La OC toma el peor veredicto de sus líneas: Aceptar · Revisar (a quién) · No aceptar; más sus alertas

SpecNodeDoc:negocio-decision.parcial.title: Aceptar + PARTIAL_STOCK: se acepta y se avisa qué falta (pendiente Karina)

SpecNodeDoc:negocio-decision.pendiente_s.title: Aceptar + PENDIENTE_STOCK: sin stock hoy, ingreso confirmado a tiempo en el informe PEND (DEC-128, REG-4)

SpecNodeDoc:negocio-decision.peor.title: La línea toma el peor resultado de sus reglas

SpecNodeDoc:negocio-decision.r1.title: R1 · ¿Producto identificado? (SKU del maestro 70.12 o lectura de la línea)

SpecNodeDoc:negocio-decision.r2.title: R2 · Stock libre del SKU (sumando lotes; un lote vencido no cuenta)

SpecNodeDoc:negocio-decision.r3.title: R3 · ¿Vence en más de 12 meses calendario? (sin fecha de vencimiento → Revisar)

SpecNodeDoc:negocio-decision.r4.title: R4 · ¿El stock que cubre está reservado (cautela)?

SpecNodeDoc:negocio-decision.r5.title: R5 · ¿El precio calza con el collective number del cliente? En la misma unidad (por caja o por unidad mínima) y sin redondear

SpecNodeDoc:negocio-decision.revisar_ins.title: Revisar (Customer Service) + RESERVA_INSTITUCIONAL: usa reserva institucional, requiere autorización (REG-3)

SpecNodeDoc:negocio-decision.revisar_r1.title: Revisar: problema de homologación (decisión del CTO 2026-10-13)

SpecNodeDoc:negocio-decision.revisar_r3.title: Revisar (Comercial): negociar con el cliente, sin descuento automático

SpecNodeDoc:negocio-decision.revisar_r4.title: Revisar (Customer Service): nunca No aceptar por una reserva ajena

SpecNodeDoc:negocio-decision.revisar_r5.title: Revisar (Comercial) (PROVISIONAL: la fuente dice por definir)
